name: Hailo-10H

flops.basis_detail: Hailo-10H M.2 product page states 'Featuring the Hailo-10H AI accelerator with 40|20 TOPS (INT4|8)'. INT4 recorded as 40 TOPS.
Hailo-10H M.2 product page states 'Featuring the Hailo-10H AI accelerator with 40|20 TOPS (INT4|8)'. INT8 recorded as 20 TOPS.

notes:
REAL VENDOR: Hailo (Tel Aviv, Israel). Set to 'asic-other' because the schema enum does not include 'hailo'. Hailo-10H is Hailo's second-generation AI accelerator targeting generative AI, LLMs, and vision models at the edge. The Hailo-10H M.2 module provides 40 TOPS INT4 and 20 TOPS INT8 compute at a typical power consumption of 2.5W. Memory is offered as 4GB or 8GB LPDDR4/4X (recorded at upper 8GB configuration). The module interfaces via PCIe Gen 3.0 x4 in M.2 2242 and 2280 Key M form factors. Software workflow is driven by the Hailo AI Software Suite and HailoRT runtime, compiling models from ONNX, LiteRT (TensorFlow Lite), and PyTorch (cross-referencing local-litert and local-onnxruntime-mobile workflows).
MEMORY_BUS_WIDTH AND BANDWIDTH: STILL NULL, AND HERE IS PRECISELY WHAT WAS LOOKED FOR (2026-10-11). Hailo publishes 4|8GB LPDDR4/4X capacity but does not disclose the bus width (bits) or memory bandwidth (GB/s) on the module spec sheet. No figure was back-computed from memory speed or TOPS.
